config.grain_rationale: One record is a single employment-services provider SITE (a physical service-delivery location) contracted under a DEWR program; the site's operator is a business participant, so SITE_NAME is mapped to entity.trading_name (a business/brand name, not a registered legal name). DIS_SITE_CODE identifies the site, not the business, so it is not used as a business identifier.

record_id.rationale: DIS_SITE_CODE is not unique per record (489 distinct across 505 discovery rows, and repeated rows carry different CONTRACT_NAME/ESA_CD_1 values; some codes are non-geographic placeholders such as EFTZ). No other candidate key is unique, so a content hash over the row is the only traceable identifier.

fields.rationale: SITE_NAME holds the provider's public brand/trading names (MAX Employment, Advanced Personnel Management, Job Centre Australia, CoAct/Community Solutions) as used on site listings. No evidence it is the registered legal name, so trading_name is the safe target.
SITE_URL holds the operator's website (www.apm.net.au, orsgroup.com.au, wiseemployment.com.au), present in 57.6% of rows. It is the provider's web presence, not a site-specific page.
Street address line of the service-delivery site; scope is the contracted premises, not a registered office. Values are truncated at about 45 chars in the source but remain usable address lines.
Suburb/town of the site; matches LOCATION_NAME almost exactly (412 distinct each).
Two/three-letter AU state abbreviations only (NSW, VIC, QLD, SA, WA, TAS, ACT, NT; 8 distinct values, no overseas entries).
4-digit AU postcodes present 97% (492/505); 13 three-digit values are NT codes such as 822 which the postcode transform re-pads.

constants.rationale: Australian Government (DEWR) employment services register; all records carry AU state codes and 4-digit AU postcodes.

Duplicates SITE_LOCALITY_NAME (412 distinct each); no added value over address.locality.

Employment Services Area geography code (e.g. 5ACT, 4SOE, 5MRV) denoting the service region of the site, not an ANZSIC industry code and not an entity identifier.

config.notes: Source is a site-level register: no ABN, ACN, legal entity name, entity type, status or registration date is present, so none of those is mapped. SITE_NAME is treated as trading_name only; the operator's registered legal name cannot be established from this file. No date columns exist, so observation.observed_at falls back to resource last-modified and no validity dates are asserted. Records repeat the same site under different CONTRACT_NAME/ESA_CD geography combinations, which is why content_hash is used for record_id.

fields.reason: SITE_NAME 是站点上公开展示的服务品牌/运营名称（Vision Australia、Job Centre Australia、Sarina Russo Job Access），没有证据显示它是注册法律名称，因此映射到 entity.trading_name 是稳妥的选择。注意：'OCTEC Limited' 这类值包含公司后缀，可能是法律名称，只把它作为 trading_name 是偏保守而非错误；不应再额外推断 legal_name。

SITE_URL 是运营商的网站，而非某个站点的专用页面（多个记录共用同一域名），可以归属到 entity.website。website 转换接受 'www.visionaustralia.org.au' 这类不带 scheme 的值，只在空值时才省略，从而产生观测记录。然而，请注意 'http://www.novaemployment.com.au' 原样通过，而其他值不带 scheme——即规范化不一致，但目标本身仍是正确的字段。
SITE_ADDRESS_LN 是服务交付站点的街道地址行，因此 claim_scope 使用 establishment_address 是正确的，并且有明确声明，不会是注册办公室地址。原始行被截断约 45 个字符（例如仍可用的 'Ang Gnarra Co-Op Peninsula Development Road'），这保留为地址行是可以的。
SITE_LOCALITY_NAME 是站点的郊区/城镇，可直接映射到 address.locality，作用域为 establishment_address，与 STATE/POSTCODE 一致。
SITE_STATE_CD 仅包含 8 个澳大利亚州/领地缩写，通过 state 转换映射到 address.state；所有留出项都正确生成 ACT/NSW/NT/QLD/VIC/SA，作用域为 establishment_address。
SITE_POSTCODE 是澳大利亚站点邮政编码；补零转换将 NT 的三位数 '850' 修正为 '0850'，且保持四位数不变（2601、2830、3076、4871、5118、2780、2795、2444、2650、2594）。在 establishment_address 作用域下设定是正确的。
常量 AU 有充分理由：DEWR 澳大利亚政府登记册，所有记录都包含澳大利亚州代码和澳大利亚邮政编码；没有 NZ 或其他司法管辖区的证据。

missed.suggested_target: entity.industry_code（或 entity 的 programme 属性，若无该属性则保持未映射）
missed.reason: 虽然该值（DESA/DESB/EPS5/TTW5/RJCP/NEI5/HLS5）是计划/合同代码，而不是 ANZSIC，但它是唯一能标识所交付服务类型（就业服务计划）的列；值得记录原始值，而不是完全丢弃。若没有扩展属性，则保留未映射是合理的，因为把它映射到 industry_code 会是错误的。

missed.suggested_target: entity.website（不——正确省略），或来源备注的通用联系字段
missed.reason: 没有电子邮件目标，但值得注意的是，若干值是个人邮箱（kal.perera@visionaustralia.org、l.sarago@mpth.com.au、Rebecca_Venning@aep.salvationarmy.org），因此绝不能映射到任何实体/联系人名称字段；尽管有一个是 'deewrcontracts@novaemployment.com.au'，它可支持运营商域名，但映射到 website 会是不正确的推断。

critic.summary: 此映射对其声明的粒度（一个承包商服务站点）是合理的。SITE_NAME 被正确视为 trading_name，而非 legal_name；SITE_URL 被正确视为实体网站；地址列被一致且明确地限定为 establishment_address，而非注册办公室；NT 3 位邮政编码的补零是正确的，没有月份/日期问题，也没有对 deregistered 状态或日期有效性的误用（此处未发出日期，因此没有错误附加的有效性）。基于枚举或标识符的损坏规则均不存在。仅剩的小问题是：website 值未规范化（部分保留了 http:// 前缀），以及少数看起来像法律名称的 SITE_NAME 值（OCTEC Limited）；但将这些值与保守处理相结合并未产生错误目标。未映射列表是合理的；唯一值得重新审视的遗漏是 CONTRACT_NAME，它可能作为原始 programme 属性保留，而不是丢弃。

config.notes: Source is a site-level register: no ABN, ACN, legal entity name, entity type, status or registration date is present, so none of those is mapped. SITE_NAME is treated as trading_name only; the operator's registered legal name cannot be established from this file (some values such as 'OCTEC Limited' look legal but cannot be proven, so legal_name is not asserted). No date columns exist, so observation.observed_at falls back to resource last-modified and no validity dates are asserted. SITE_URL is guarded by a TLD-anchored regex because holdout rows carry phone numbers in that column; genuine domains are unchanged.

fields.reason: SITE_NAME displays the provider's public or brand name (Vision Australia, Job Centre Australia, NOVA Employment, The Salvation Army Employment Plus); it is not evidence of a registered legal name, so mapping it to trading_name is right, not legal_name. Note that 'OCTEC Limited' and 'Parkes Forbes Business Enterprise Centre' look like legal names, but a cautious emer target choice remains acceptable. Also, no claim_scope was supplied, so a site listing name might be mistaken for the entity's brand-wide trading name; this is acceptable but worth noting.

The regex-extract with a TLD anchor keeps real domains and rejects phone-like values ('TTY: 03 96143062', 1800 numbers). Heldout values such as www.visionaustralia.org.au, http://www.novaemployment.com.au and www.iim.net.au produce correct websites; blanks produce no observation. Site-level URL is the operator's website, which is reasonable.

This is the site's street address line, and claim_scope is establishment_address, which matches the site-premises grain. However, 'Ang Gnarra Co-Op Peninsula Development Road' has no street number and is an unmasked site name that looks truncated; it is still an address line, so no error that changes the meaning. It would be good to state that truncated lines are only the address line, not address.full.
Site locality is used for address.locality with establishment_address scope; heldout values (CANBERRA, WAGGA WAGGA, KATHERINE, Gayndah) are valid localities, and mixed case is preserved.
SITE_STATE_CD contains AU state abbreviations only; the state transform maps ACT, NSW, NT, QLD, SA correctly, and no overseas values appear.

The padding of a 3-digit NT value ('850' to '0850') is plausible, but the rationale gives no evidence that these codes are NT-numeric; the state transform is applied separately and might disagree. The origin of the padding (leading zeros) is assumed; this carries moderate risk, not clearly wrong.
The constant AU country is supported by the publisher (Australian Government), AU state codes, and 4-digit AU postcodes in all heldout rows.

missed.reason: Not a valid website target, but the domains in site emails (novaemployment.com.au, iim.net.au, bec.net.au) could fill website gaps. This is lower priority: do not emit an email as a website.

Rows such as 'OCTEC Limited' and 'The Salvation Army Employment Plus' contain legal-form tokens; without ABN or ACN support, however, legal_name_must_not_be guessed. It is better left unmapped; listed only for completeness.

critic.summary: Address block (rules 2-6) is consistent with a site/establishment grain and correctly scoped; no registered-office confusion and no licence/contract number misused as a business identifier (DIS_SITE_CODE and CONTRACT_NAME correctly left unmapped). Trading name vs legal name is the main risk area: SITE_NAME is displayed brand text, so trading_name is defensible, but names with legal suffixes (OCTEC Limited) and site names are blend into one target without claim_scope; doubtful rather than wrong. Rule 5's 3-digit NT postcode padding is an inference not backed by evidence in the rationale. Website regex is sound. No validity dates are emitted so no validity-path defects; status/entity_type/ABN were not mapped, which is correct given no source columns.
